offering_description.value: Grows, manufactures and sells cannabis products under its own brands through company-owned retail stores and wholesale to licensed dispensaries. Serves state-licensed adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; pre-rolls; topicals

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients; B2B: licensed dispensaries and cannabis retailers buying wholesale product

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold through company stores and wholesale to licensed dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cultivates and manufactures cannabis products in its own facilities, sold to its stores and dispensaries; brand owner: markets its own cannabis product brands to consumers and retailers; retailer: operates company-owned dispensaries selling directly to consumers and patients

geography_served.value: US national: licensed operations in several states, including Illinois, Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Nevada and Ohio

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis flower, vape products, edibles, pre-rolls and topicals sold under its brands and through its stores

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned retail dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale supply to independent licensed dispensaries in partner states

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licenses to cultivate, manufacture and sell, overseen by state cannabis agencies and subject to federal drug law

notes: Cannabis remains federally illegal, and the state footprint and company size described may have changed since my information was last updated.
